name: techgedoens
title: Techgedöns.de
description: The official Raycast extension for the German tech blog Techgedöns.de
author: Marcelismus

preferences.name: allArticlesInitialFilter
preferences.title: Initial Article Filter
preferences.description: Selects the read status shown when opening All Articles.

preferences.name: articleEnterAction
preferences.title: Return Key Action
preferences.description: Selects whether Return shows the article in Raycast or opens it in the default browser.

preferences.name: archiveRetention
preferences.title: Keep Articles
preferences.description: Selects when stored articles are removed from the complete article list.

preferences.name: archivePageSize
preferences.title: Articles per Load
preferences.description: Selects how many articles are initially shown and loaded at the end of the list.

commands.name: latest-articles
commands.title: Latest Articles
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Lists the latest articles from Techgedoens.de

commands.name: all-articles
commands.title: All Articles
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Shows the saved article archive with read status and topic filters

commands.name: search-selected-text
commands.title: Search Selected Text
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Searches Techgedöns.de for text selected in the frontmost application

commands.name: search-techgedoens
commands.title: Search Techgedöns
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Searches the complete Techgedöns.de article archive

commands.name: refresh-articles
commands.title: Refresh Articles
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Silently refreshes the local Techgedoens.de article cache

commands.name: open-techgedoens
commands.title: Open Techgedöns.de
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Opens Techgedöns.de in the default browser

commands.name: menu-bar-articles
commands.title: Techgedöns Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Techgedöns.de
commands.description: Shows the unread count and latest articles in the menu bar

preferences.name: showMenuBarArticleDate
preferences.title: Article Details
preferences.description: Shows the publication date next to each article in the menu bar.
preferences.label: Show publication date

preferences.name: showMenuBarArticleCategory
preferences.description: Shows the category next to each article in the menu bar.
preferences.label: Show category

tools.name: search-articles
tools.title: Search Articles
tools.description: Searches the public Techgedöns.de archive and returns the five most relevant articles with their full RSS content

tools.name: get-latest-articles
tools.title: Get Latest Articles
tools.description: Returns the five latest articles published on Techgedöns.de

tools.name: get-article
tools.title: Get Article
tools.description: Loads a specific Techgedöns.de article by its exact title or URL
